description: A per-column analyzer override entry. Specifies which analyzers to use at index time and search time for a specific column.

columnName.description: The name of the column to override. Must exist in the entity's schema.

indexAnalyzerId.description: The ID of the TextAnalyzer to use when indexing this column.

searchAnalyzerId.description: The ID of the TextAnalyzer to use when searching this column.
